attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: কোনো সিদ্ধান্ত বা ব্যবস্থার গোড়ার কারণগুলোর ব্যাখ্যা।

definition.oewn_definition: (law) an explanation of the fundamental reasons (especially an explanation of the working of some device in terms of laws of nature)
definition.text: (law) an explanation of the fundamental reasons (especially an explanation of the working of some device in terms of laws of nature)

examples.bn: নতুন ঘণ্টার সময়ের মূল যুক্তি ছিল গেটে লাইন ছোট করা।
examples.en: The rationale for the new bell times was shorter queues at the gate.
